name: Planning Data document type dataset
fact: Seven document types are exposed, including notices, Article 4 documents, authoritative boundaries and designation reports.
gate: Document classification alone does not prove the current legal effect of any document.

name: Salford Local Information Requirements
fact: The Salford local-information-requirements record points to the authority's current web guidance and is marked quality 'some'.
gate: Local validation guidance is process evidence and requires current authority-page confirmation before use.

name: Haringey Local Requirements
fact: The Haringey record links a local validation-requirements document and authority guidance; quality is recorded as 'some'.
gate: Historic document links or consultation material must not be treated as current validation requirements without authority confirmation.

name: Camden Local Area Requirements
fact: The Camden record links its local-area-requirements document and authority page; quality is 'some'.
gate: The listed period/document date must be revalidated before applying requirements to a live application.

name: Cornwall Local Requirements
fact: The Cornwall record links the council validation guide and guidance page; quality is 'some'.
gate: Validation requirements can change and are not evidence of planning acceptability or consent.

name: South Bucks supporting information requirements
fact: The record points to Buckinghamshire supporting-information guidance and notes that the information is provided on a webpage.
gate: Webpage-based requirements need current authority confirmation and do not establish permission.

name: Bristol planning application requirements
fact: The Bristol record links planning-application local-list requirements with a period start date in 2022.
gate: Older period metadata must be checked against the current Bristol validation list before use.

name: Central Bedfordshire local requirements
fact: The Central Bedfordshire record links local validation requirements and is marked quality 'some'.
gate: Alternative-source metadata is not authoritative proof that every listed requirement is currently in force.

name: Dartmoor validation checklist
fact: The Dartmoor record links an adopted validation checklist and planning-applications guidance; quality is 'some'.
gate: The checklist's publication date must be checked before applying it to a current proposal.

name: Westminster local list of requirements
fact: The Westminster record links its full planning-validation requirements and authority guidance page; quality is 'some'.
gate: Validation requirements determine submission completeness, not permission or development viability.

name: East Riding developer agreement contribution example
fact: The record links contribution 20/01073/S106/19 to developer agreement 20/01073/S106 and records contribution purpose 'other'.
gate: A contribution record must be reconciled with agreement status and transactions before inferring funding or obligations.

name: Dover developer agreement affordable-housing contribution
fact: The authoritative Dover contribution record links to a developer agreement and records 10 units for affordable-housing purpose.
gate: Recorded units are an agreement contribution, not evidence that units have been delivered or remain outstanding.

name: Government response on streamlining infrastructure planning
fact: The government response states the refreshed National Infrastructure Planning Guidance suite comes into effect on 24 July 2026 and links this to Planning and Infrastructure Act reforms.
gate: Reform commencement changes process guidance but does not confer consent or site-level value uplift.

name: BR00003 Wembley High Road
fact: The authoritative Brent record is permissioned for 394 dwellings and notes one permission had started and was subtracted from allocation capacity, but the entity's displayed entry date is 18 March 2022.
gate: Older entity date and started phases require live register/completion reconciliation before any remaining-capacity use.

name: RBBCBLR020 Marketfield Way High Street Redhill
fact: The Reigate and Banstead record has a 2026 entry date but end date 31 December 2020, historic full permission and 150 dwellings.
gate: Explicit end date makes this historical evidence; it must not be promoted as current capacity.

name: RBBCBLR046 Reigate Library
fact: The 2026 authoritative record covers 0.04ha, public ownership, 25 dwellings, not-permissioned status and a wider opportunity-area allocation with relocation requirements.
gate: Allocation plus public ownership is not consent and relocation dependencies must be resolved before promotion.

name: RBBCBLR013 sustainable urban extension site
fact: The 2026 Reigate and Banstead record identifies land within a wider Sustainable Urban Extension allocation including residential and other uses.
gate: Wider-site allocation must be matched to exact parcel geometry, current policy and permission status.

name: RBBCBLR098 Reigate and Banstead
fact: The record is permissioned but carries end date 31 December 2023 and historic prior-approval information.
gate: End-dated permission evidence is historical and excluded from current candidate capacity.

name: RBBCBLR097 Reigate and Banstead
fact: Planning Data explicitly labels the record out of date with end date 31 December 2023 despite historic residential prior approvals.
gate: Out-of-date records are hard rejections unless a newer authoritative record supersedes them.

name: RBBCBLR155 Reigate and Banstead
fact: The 2026 record notes a wider site was promoted for redevelopment but has been split because some parts are no longer available for residential development.
gate: Promotion history and partial availability require exact current boundary and land-availability verification.

name: RBBCBLR110 Reigate and Banstead
fact: The authoritative record has end date 31 December 2020 and not-permissioned status following a refused application history.
gate: End-dated/refused historical evidence is excluded from current candidate counts.

name: RBBCBLR138 Reigate and Banstead
fact: The record shows historic permission but an end date of 31 December 2025.
gate: End-dated permissioned records must not be treated as current remaining capacity.

name: RBBCBLR034 Reigate and Banstead
fact: The current record identifies a residential allocation for 20 homes and notes temporary/community-use planning history after demolition.
gate: Allocation and temporary-use history require live planning and availability checks; no consent is inferred for the residential allocation.

name: RBBCBLR092 Reigate and Banstead
fact: Planning Data explicitly marks this record out of date with end date 31 December 2020 despite historic outline/reserved-matters approvals.
gate: Historic approvals cannot override an explicit out-of-date state.

name: RBBCBLR104 Reigate and Banstead
fact: The current record notes a wider mixed-use allocation and an October 2023 outline permission for 53 extra-care apartments on part of the site.
gate: Part-site permission must be reconciled with exact geometry, phases and remaining allocation before any capacity score.

name: BR00167 Brent brownfield site
fact: The Brent authoritative record lists 80 dwellings, permissioned status and notes that capacity/site outline were updated to match the local plan.
gate: Permissioned capacity still requires live commencement/completion and exact geometry checks.

name: BR00243 Atlip Road Brent
fact: The 2026 Brent record lists 450 dwellings, not-permissioned status and Local Plan allocation BSWSA3.
gate: Allocation and capacity are not consent; exact title, availability and current planning status remain required.

name: BR00226 OK Club Brent
fact: The 2026 Brent record is public-owned, not-permissioned and linked to Local Plan allocation BSESA16.
gate: Public ownership plus allocation does not prove permission, disposal availability or deliverability.
